readback.body: Packages and verifies the governed v8 GPU model bundle, launches the supervised Web/SmartCluster stack on port 8888, and exercises executable JABLE, Chimera, Hyperion, and JOPE Prime paths. The public installer supports independently configurable train/predict and Prime deadlines up to seven days, headerless Allstate-style regression train/test input, feature-only prediction, and a final report-only external R2 artifact that cannot influence training or model selection. Digest-reference normalization preserves registry ports and immutable image references. Focused installer tests, Bash syntax, ShellCheck, and diff hygiene pass; the detached required lane will bind merge evidence to this exact head.
readback.title: feat(deploy): ship governed Jain GPU cockpit
